tienda.ayuda:
tienda — runs the practice store from inside the container.

  tienda error estado              which seeded errors are on
  tienda error E1 on|off           turns one on or off (E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 or E8)
  tienda reiniciar                 puts the store back to just-opened (errors stay as they were)
  tienda reloj 2026-12-31T23:59:58 sets the store's time (Mexico City time)
  tienda reloj real                goes back to the real time
  tienda pasarela aprueba          the payment gateway approves (also: rechaza, no-contesta, tarda 8)
  tienda pedido 3 avanzar          moves order 3 to its next state (like the warehouse or the courier)
